no_replication_of_published_method.not_a.reason: The contribution is a controlled comparison: raw sensor, ordinary Fourier and log-odds Fourier IC descriptors fed into the reference parameter encoder. I found no evidence that a specific prior follow-up's encoding and conclusions were reproduced without acknowledgment. Confidence is medium because a web literature search was not permitted.
